items.title: Starbucks rises as Stifel resumes coverage with Buy rating and $115 target
items.summary: Investing.com -- Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) shares rose 3.8% in Monday trading after Stifel resumed coverage with a Buy rating and a $115 price target. The positive reaction reflects growing market confidence that the coffeehouse chain is establishing durable operating traction under its ongoing turnaround strategy.
